specReview.fallbackCondition: Run full spec review when required fields are missing, migration parity inventory is incomplete, requirements conflict with scope, or manifest validation reports boundary confidence.
specReview.behaviorVerification: Spec-review PASS/FAIL must match existing blocking criteria for missing acceptance, contradictory fields, migration parity gaps, and untestable requirements.

implReview.fallbackCondition: Run full impl-review when changed hunks exceed manifest limits, public API/schema/config changed, file-map is incomplete, risky patterns are inconclusive, or previous blocking findings lack resolution evidence.
implReview.behaviorVerification: Impl-review blocking failure modes missing_acceptance_requirement, spec_behavior_contradiction, and security_or_data_integrity_bug remain detectable through manifest or full AI fallback.
